svg.title: SNS Spring Boot support map
svg.desc: AWS SNS auto-configuration creates a coroutine operations API for topics, FIFO publishing, SMS publishing, and HTTP subscription confirmation helpers.
svg.text: SNS support wraps the async SDK with coroutine topic, publish, SMS, and confirmation operations.
Standard topics reject FIFO-only fields; SMS maps explicit SNS attributes.
Parser validates shape and cert URL only.
Callers must verify signature, certificate chain, and expected TopicArn.
SNS support covers standard/FIFO topics, direct SMS publish, HTTP message parsing, and explicit subscription confirmation.
